source_text: However, the study has been critiqued for limitations including small numbers of affected circumcised individuals (e.g., ~10 men with frequent orgasm difficulties), potential overfitting in logistic models with many predictors, lack of correction for multiple comparisons, wide confidence intervals indicating imprecision, low-to-moderate response rates (~48-54%), and possible confounding (many circumcisions for medical reasons like phimosis that may independently affect sexual function).
